enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Keep body still. Breathe. Turn onto left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Place arm under pillow. Turn onto right side. Adjust pillow under head. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Turn onto back. Move arm to side. Keep eyes closed. Remain lying down. Sleep. Wake at 07:05.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove sleepwear. Step into shower. Turn on shower tap. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower tap. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open wardrobe. Pick up clothes. Put on shirt. Put on trousers. Put on socks. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, eggs, and milk. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Crack eggs into bowl. Stir eggs. Place frying pan on induction cooker. Press power button. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Take toast. Put toast on plate. Fill kettle with water. Press kettle switch. Pour water into mug. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Stand. Carry plate to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Drinking morning coffee, checking the day's schedule on phone, light tidying of the room
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Scroll schedule. Tap event. Read details. Put phone on table. Pick up coffee mug. Sip coffee. Put mug on table. Pick up cushion. Place cushion on sofa. Pick up magazine. Stack magazines. Wipe coffee table with cloth. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone in pocket. Pick up mug. Sip coffee. Put mug on table. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on the computer, coordinating community programs, answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Sit at desk. Press computer power button. Open email program. Read email. Type reply. Click send. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Pick up phone. Call community partner. Say 'Hello, this is Member 1.' Place phone down. Open document. Draft program outline. Save file. Read new email. Type response. Click send. Stand. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 2, then loading the dishwasher together
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, bread, and cheese. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Cut vegetables. Place bread and cheese on plates. Member 2 enters kitchen. Say 'Lunch is ready.' Carry plates to table. Sit down. Eat lunch with Member 2. Stand. Pick up plates. Carry to sink. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Place cups in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe counter with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Short break, stretching and looking out the window
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Look out window. Stretch arms overhead. Bend forward. Turn head left. Turn head right. Rotate shoulders. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Check time. Put phone down. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on the computer, attending online meetings and drafting program plans
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Click meeting link. Say 'Can everyone hear me?' Listen. Take notes on paper. Type. Open document. Draft program plan. Click save. Open spreadsheet. Enter budget. Join second meeting. Mute microphone. Unmute. Say 'I will share the timeline.' Click share screen. Stop share. Leave meeting. Stand. Stretch. Sit. Continue typing. Close document.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down after work, having afternoon tea and stretching with Member 2, watching TV and resting on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Member 2 is on sofa. Say 'Tea is ready.' Pick up mug. Sit on sofa. Pick up TV remote. Press power button. Select channel. Sip tea. Place mug on coaster. Stretch arms. Member 2 stretches. Lean back on sofa. Pick up remote. Change channel. Place remote on armrest. Lean head on cushion. Place hands on lap. Sit up. Pick up mug. Sip tea. Put mug down.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with Member 2 on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, tofu, and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take knife. Cut vegetables. Member 2 takes pot. Fill pot with water. Place pot on induction cooker. Press power button. Add vegetables. Stir with spoon. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plates. Member 2 carries pot. Walk to table.

Sit at table. Pick up chopsticks. Pick up food. Eat. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Talk with Member 2: 'The program plan is nearly ready.' Pick up more food. Eat. Put chopsticks down. Wipe mouth with napkin. Pick up cup. Drink. Talk. Pick up chopsticks. Finish food. Stand. Pick up plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and tidying the kitchen with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Carry to sink. Scrape leftovers into bin. Stack plates. Pick up cups. Carry to sink. Rinse plates. Place plates in dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Wipe counter. Close refrigerator. Hang cloth on hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with Member 2 to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Select program. Place remote on armrest. Watch TV. Lean back. Pick up cushion. Place behind head. Member 2 sits. Say 'This show is funny.' Laugh. Pick up water glass. Drink. Place glass on table. Cross legs. Pick up remote. Change volume. Put remote down. Stretch arms. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and playing on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up game controller. Press power button on console. Pick up TV remote. Switch input. Put TV remote down. Select game. Press start. Hold controller. Press buttons. Move joystick. Play. Pause game. Put controller down. Stand. Sit. Pick up controller. Continue. Press pause. Save game. Turn off console. Put controller on shelf.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Pick up plates from table. Carry to sink. Scrape food into bin. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Pull out bottom rack. Place plates in rack. Place cups in top rack. Pick up forks. Place in basket. Close dishwasher door. Press start button. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal time reading and browsing on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Place book on desk. Open computer. Click browser. Scroll news. Click article. Read. Open social media. Scroll. Type comment. Click post. Close browser. Close computer. Stand. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush in holder. Turn off tap. Wash face with cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter Bedroom 1. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Place head on pillow. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn onto side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Place arm on chest. Keep eyes closed. Remain in bed. Sleep.
